concept_decisions: Retain concept wide cohesive silt wall, steep joints, eroded apron and irregular crest. Reduce concept fine grain and layered sandstone-like horizontal markings: broad homogeneous sediment facets with only subtle soil cap. Unequal vertical incisions continue into crest gullies. One continuous closed volume, not separate column cylinders or a cliff skin stacked on terrain. Sloping rear and irregular natural ends, no rectangular pedestal or tiled face. No sign, road, plants or landscape used as substitute for the face.
